Analysis for REQ-006 is written, with six acceptance criteria and no blocking questions.

## Files written
- `aiws/work/REQ-006/01-analysis.md` — the only file touched. `questions.md` was not needed.

I could not run the orchestrator's parser (Bash is denied in this run). I checked the file with the same patterns the parser uses: AC-1..AC-6 in order, all five required headings, and no line that would be read as a blocking question.

## Acceptance criteria
| AC | Covers | Side |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AC-1 | Empty list while filtering shows a "no customer matches the filter" sentence; "Chưa có khách hàng." stays for "Tất cả" | FE |
| AC-2 | While filtering, a second click on **any** status button within 500 ms of a processed click is ignored | FE |
| AC-3 | Clicks outside that case are still processed; under "Tất cả" the per-customer rule of REQ-004 is unchanged | FE |
| AC-4 | "Added" notice shows if and only if the add succeeded and the new customer does not match the filter | FE |
| AC-5 | TC-117, TC-118, TC-120, TC-122 assert directly what review findings 1–3 name; codes, names, data rows and the 399 run count stay | BE tests |
| AC-6 | `notFound500` in TC-127 is renamed; nothing else in the test changes | FE test |

## What the design reviewer must decide or accept
- **Double-click rule (Q2):** while filtering, a deliberate click on a different customer within 500 ms is also ignored, with no feedback. This reverses REQ-005 D10 (option A) and narrows REQ-004 D1 and the last variant of its AC-2 while filtering. I followed the requirement's "khi đang lọc"; the alternative is the same rule under "Tất cả" too.
- **Notice condition (Q4):** I assumed the notice appears only when the new customer is not in the filtered list, which today means only under "Ngừng hoạt động". The alternative is to show it after every successful add.
- **Notice placement (Q5):** `#message` is styled as an error (`class="error" role="alert"`), so a success notice there would show in red. The architect has to choose where and how it appears.
- **Wording:** "Không có khách hàng nào khớp lựa chọn lọc." and "Đã thêm khách hàng." are assumed sentences (Q1, Q5).

## Things a reviewer must know
- **No backend production change.** The BE diff is two test files only, and BE must stay at exactly 399 runs.
- **Five existing tests are modified.** TC-117, TC-118, TC-120, TC-122 and TC-127 keep their codes and display names, so the REQ-006 test spec has to redefine them (REQ-004 precedent). The orchestrator's check that a TC code is present passes before any edit, so the reviewer has to read those five diffs.
- **New TC codes start at TC-135.**
- **Each FE criterion needs a testable unit.** `main.js` and `index.html` have no automated tests, so each of AC-1..AC-4 needs its decision in a unit outside `main.js`.
- **Scope assumptions on the findings:**
  - Finding 2 covers exactly what it names (five fields, `phone` present, JSON `null` for ids 1 and 4), not the literal phone values for ids 2 and 3 (Q8).
  - Changing TC-119 to share the helper is optional (Q7).
  - The two "not counted as findings" notes in the REQ-005 review are out of scope.
- **Not reproduced:** the double-click case has no recorded manual reproduction in the repo; it is marked `[CẦN XÁC NHẬN]`.
